releaseName: Lokify v1.5.2 – Direct Satellite Map View by Default
changelog: Direct Satellite View: Map page and feed map now open directly in high-resolution satellite view with crisp street and landmark overlays.
Native Package Installer: In-app installer writes to external files directory with ClipData URI permission routing for seamless 1-tap installation.
Dynamic Settings Version: Pinned settings screen and about dialog to dynamic package inspection directly from Android OS.
